identity.name: Parkland Royale
identity.notes: Guard-gated, master-planned single-family community built by Lennar on 76.85 acres (just under 77 acres) in northwest Parkland, FL 33076, near the intersection of Loxahatchee Road and Bishop Road. 205 homesites across two collections: Crown (estate-scale, 4 plans ~3,400–4,400 sq ft, 3-car garages, 4–6 bedrooms, from ~$1.16M) and Monarch (lower price point), with an optional Next Gen suite on select plans for multigenerational living. Lennar's Everything's Included program bundles quartz counters, stainless appliances, and impact windows into base price. Official price range $1,099,990–$1,630,865; 8 homes available at time of listing. Sales center at 9520 Majestic Way. Positioned as a suburb of Miami, roughly an hour from the metro area.

fees.note: HOA dues are required in addition to purchase price, but no exact monthly/annual amount is stated in the provided content.
CDD payments are required on top of purchase price, but no exact amount is stated in the provided content.

HOA fee exists and funds gate staffing, common-area landscaping, amenity center upkeep, and community management. Exact amount not stated on page; article says figures shift by build-out phase and must be confirmed with the sales center at 9520 Majestic Way. (A CommunityPay directory search snippet claimed a median fee of $383/mo, but the figure did not appear in the page text retrieved, so it is unverified.) Confidence 0.6 (reputable buyer-guide blog, not official HOA).

Separate CDD assessment exists (financed infrastructure, roads, utilities, amenities; paid via property tax bill). Exact amount and payoff term (e.g., 30 years vs. upfront) not stated; article says amounts vary by phase/section and should be confirmed per homesite. Confidence 0.6 (reputable buyer-guide blog, not official CDD).
